links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated hysterectomy patient education responses versus ASA website
links.effect: ChatGPT and Gemini had significantly higher professionalism than the ASA website (P<.05) but lower readability (P<.05); no significant ChatGPT-Gemini differences.
links.quote: ChatGPT and Gemini demonstrated significantly higher professionalism scores than the ASA website (P <.05); however, their readability was lower (P <.05).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM-generated patient education responses compared to professional medical society materials on professionalism, readability, and content quality.
